# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (Mar 4, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw critical bug fixes in CI processes and the `op-acceptor` component, ensuring smoother development workflows and correct test exclusions. Discussions continued on several active issues, including L2CM documentation and Glamsterdam gas pricing impacts.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### CI Pipeline Enhancements
A fix was implemented to address a CI failure in the `go-release` job by ensuring the `zstd` utility is installed for `mise` archive extraction. This resolves issues with setting up the development environment in CI workflows ([#561](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/561)).

### `op-acceptor` Test Exclusion Logic Refinement
The `op-acceptor` component received a bug fix to correctly handle named test exclusions in gateless mode. Previously, the `--exclude-gates` flag failed for named tests due to an empty `FuncName` in gateless mode, which has now been resolved ([#560](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/560)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES

### L2 Contracts Manager Documentation
A new issue was opened to document the "no-storage-variables" convention for the `L2ContractsManager`. This is a critical follow-up to prevent storage variable collisions with `L2ProxyAdmin` slots, which could lead to admin access lockouts ([#19391](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19391)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Initial EL Sync UX and Correctness
Discussions continued regarding the `op-node`'s behavior during initial EL Sync, specifically concerning how it marks blocks as finalized. The core concern is that the `op-node` and EL might prematurely consider blocks finalized even if they are not, especially when the sequencer is still syncing. Questions were raised about whether this bug is specific to light CL/interop or also present without it, how it's currently mitigated, and why light CL might exacerbate the issue. The conversation also touched upon the limitations of snap sync and the need to ensure derivation and consolidation processes align with the EL-synced unsafe chain ([#17631](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/17631)).

### Glamsterdam Gas Pricing Impacts on Precompile Acceleration
The potential impacts of Glamsterdam's gas pricing changes on precompile acceleration were further discussed. Key points included the need to adjust `requiredGas` to match L1 costs and the consideration of increased call data costs when publishing large preimages and precompile inputs. A Notion document outlining precompile oracle gas cost risks was shared, and a related issue tracking `requiredGas` changes was referenced ([#19375](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19375)).

### Set default respected game type to CANNON_KONA
This issue, concerning the default game type for Upgrade 18, was moved back to "in progress." This is due to anticipated changes stemming from an upcoming pull request in the `optimism` repository ([#18640](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18640)).
